name: MGP Promethazine With Dextrethorphan Cough Syrup
description:
Buy MGP Promethazine online

MGP Promethazine With Dextrethorphan Cough Syrup is a prescription cough medicine that combines promethazine hydrochloride (an antihistamine) and dextromethorphan hydrobromide (a cough suppressant). It is commonly prescribed for the temporary relief of cough and upper respiratory symptoms associated with allergies or the common cold.

What It Is Used For | Dextrethorphan Cough Syrup

Temporary relief of dry or irritating cough

Relief of upper respiratory symptoms related to allergies or the common cold

Reduction of sneezing, runny nose, and throat irritation associated with colds and allergies
